flags.message: The snapshot's supremecourt.gov payload carries bCapitalCase=false, but the petition cover and the questions-presented file are marked CAPITAL CASE (a military-commission capital prosecution). The statpack's capital-case cut keys on the payload flag OR the docket-number annotation, so this petition is probably bucketed as unmarked; a maintainer may want to know the payload flag under-reports on commission dockets.

Justice Kavanaugh took no part in the June 29, 2026 order on the sealing motion. I treated that as a case-wide recusal and shaded the grant probability down for an eight-Justice conference; if the harness ever records participation, this is the assumption to check.
